sources: https://www.recreation.gov/camping/campgrounds/267551 (facility API, read 2026-11-24): 'There are 27 fully accessible single and five double campsites in Rock Creek Recreation Area; all with electric hook-ups. In addition, there are five walk-in tent sites without electric hookups, which are available first-come, first served only. Three bathhouses ... Each bathhouse has flush toilets and shower facilities. A dump station is located on site. An on-site host is located in the campground.'; notices 'Water spigots are shared between sites', 'Gates to the campground are closed from 10:00 p.m. to 7:00 a.m.', 'Sites 6, 10, 17, 20, and 21 are double sites'; amenities incl. Drinking Water, Showers, Electric Hookups, Creek Access; rules maxStay 13 nights (rolling 30 days), reservationCutOff 4 days; phone 423-638-4109
https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/267551/rates (read 2026-11-24): Peak Season 2026-05-05..10-28 and 2027-05-07..10-24: STANDARD ELECTRIC $20, double $40, group site $50

https://www.recreation.gov/api/search/campsites?fq=asset_id:267551 (catalog, read 2026-11-24): 31 STANDARD ELECTRIC records 03-033 (A loop 03-010, B loop 011-021 at 30 A, C loop 022-033 at 50 A; all drive-in back-in, RV/trailer lengths 26-50 ft where given, A loop site lengths 53-70 ft) plus GROUP site 1 (non-electric, 25 ft, tagged Riverfront)

summary: Cherokee NF Rock Creek confirmed open (FS 'Site Open', 2026 season May 5 - Oct 28): 31 reservable electric sites (B loop 30 A, C loop 50 A, shared water spigots), back-in to 50 ft, $20 single / $40 double; showers, flush toilets, dump; season 2027 05-07..10-24; rec.gov max stay 13. PIN MOVE ~340 m to the loops. Phone '' -> 423-638-4109. --AWH not waterfront consistent.
flags: PIN MOVE (>250 m): stored 36.1379,-82.3508 (the FS page's point, at the day-use area/CCC pond) -> ~36.1384,-82.3471, the centre of the A/B/C campsite loops on the rec.gov catalog points (~340 m east).
PHONE: '' -> 423-638-4109 (rec.gov facility phone, Unaka Ranger District). The FS page lists only the Supervisor's Office, (423) 476-9700.

WATERFRONT --AWH not waterfront (not changed): consistent. Rock Creek is a small creek 'that runs alongside' the area. The only catalog 'Riverfront' tag is on the non-electric group site 1 at the west end; the electric loops sit under canopy with no water tag.

WATER CONFLICT: the FS page template says 'Potable water is not available at this site', but rec.gov lists Drinking Water and 'Water spigots are shared between sites' (same template conflict as 4414). Wrote potable_water true from rec.gov.
SITES: rec.gov text says 27 single + 5 double electric sites; the catalog has 31 electric records (03-033; no 01/02). Wrote 31.
FCFS: the five walk-in tent sites are first-come only; every RV site is reservable (fcfs not written).
ACCESS: TN 395, 3.5 miles from Erwin; no road warnings from the agency. The FS alerts list does not name Rock Creek.
